target.title: fix(ci): bound qa-live-transports-convex git fetch with timeout
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the qa-live-transports-convex workflow could remain stuck in its `git fetch` steps until the job timeout when the Git transport stalls. This blocks the Convex live transport QA and wastes runner time.

## Why This Change Was Made

The four `git fetch` commands in the trusted-revision check now run through the repository's bounded process pattern: a 120-second deadline, followed by a 10-second termination grace period. This matches the pattern already applied to Mantis workflows in #108940 (commit 16c2bbb) and to linux-app-release in #110027. Ref selection, merge-base checks, and tag/branch validation are unchanged.

## User Impact

Maintainers get a prompt, actionable fetch failure instead of losing a Convex live transport QA runner for the full job timeout before the verification begins.

## Evidence

- Four one-line additions prepending `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 120s` to existing `git fetch` commands on lines 200, 203, 204, and 215.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Pattern consistency: matches the bounding approach in `.github/workflows/mantis-discord-status-reactions.yml` (#108940) and `.github/workflows/linux-app-release.yml` (#110027).
